title: API key test button triggers rate limit on first click
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in DevConsole, the user encountered: API key test button triggers rate limit on first click.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: API Keys
2. Observe UI state: 429 Too Many Requests

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: 429 Too Many Requests.

## Environment
- App: DevConsole
- Platform: web
